PractaLuma

Motion storyboard · Healthcare software
View Figma file ↗

The story

Opens on clinicians buried in admin, then shows the platform listening to a session and writing the note in one tap. Closes on “Humanizing Healthcare”.

Delivered

Storyboard frames, UI scenes and copy, ready for the animator, in one Figma file.

MarSimple

55-second explainer storyboard · Ad automation
View Figma file ↗

The story

Round Clock AI

Storyboard · Automotive AI
View Figma file ↗

The story

A car dealership’s missed calls become booked test drives. The AI answers, checks inventory in chat and books the visit. Tagline: “More calls answered. More leads received.”

What I did

Built the call, chat and test-drive screens and the slow-response versus instant-response comparison.

Delivered

Selected product moments as storyboard frames, with a red and black brand look.

05

SellerShark

Product storyboard · Amazon seller analytics
View Figma file ↗

The story

A sale notification looks great until Amazon’s fees come off. The video breaks down the cost line by line and lands on true net profit.

What I did

Designed the fee breakdown card, margin and net-profit callouts, and the 30-day profit chart.

Delivered

Storyboard ending on the line “Revenue’s a number. Profit is a Fact.” and a free-trial call to action.

How I work

A simple four-step process, with Figma as the one place everything lives.

1

Brief

I learn the product, the audience and the one thing the video must say.

2

Scene plan

The script becomes timed scenes, each with a single job.

3

Frames in Figma

I draw each scene with real UI screens, copy and notes.

4

Handover

Frames are ordered and labelled so animators can start straight away.
